high_level_description: This image depicts a serene and somewhat mystical scene at night. The setting appears to be a beach or coastal area, with the ocean waves gently lapping against the shore. The sky is dark, suggesting it is nighttime, and there are faint stars visible in the background, adding to the tranquil atmosphere. The most striking feature of the image is the presence of two vertical beams of light that extend from the ground into the sky. These beams are bright and appear to be emanating from the water's surface, creating a glowing effect on the waves below.
